picks.name: Tøyen Holding
picks.bio: Fredfades & Mest Seff's Oslo group, part of the Mutual Intentions crew. "Tøyen Holding 4 Ever" (July 9, 2026) follows three years of work after "Tøyen Holding 3", produced mostly by Fredfades with guest production from Kvam and The Purist.
picks.why_listen: A different lane from the electronic-heavy picks this week -- boom-bap-rooted hip-hop with live keys and bass, good if you want a change of texture mid-set.

picks.name: Om Unit
picks.source_note: Already in your library ("Reverse Logic" from Threads).
picks.bio: Bristol producer, already in your library. "Oracles" (April 14, 2026) is his first solo EP for Local Action -- five tracks including "Remember", "Rustt", "Ripples", "Healing Tool", and "Survivor".
picks.why_listen: Taut breakbeat house with jungle nods on the lead track -- a solid rhythmic bridge if you're moving between house and something more broken.

picks.name: Jack Sheen
picks.source_note: New release on The Trilogy Tapes.
picks.bio: Composer, sequel to his 2023 "Solo for Cello". "Press" (Jan 22, 2026), performed by ensemble Apartment House (violin, viola, cello, piano), applies the same techniques to a five-piece group across 14 movements.
picks.why_listen: Not a club record at all -- pitchy, kinetic, deliberately unsteady chamber composition. Worth knowing for a set's furthest-out moment, or just as a genuinely different kind of listening.
